note: Online v1 UI data for VOLTLINE. Screens: Screen_Online / Screen_Lobby / Screen_OnlineHUD / Screen_OnlineResults (+ Mobile_*) on the design canvas, boards 40–48.

roomCode.inputFilter: uppercase, drop anything not in the alphabet

nameTags.fadeOut: linear opacity 1 → 0 between 25 m and 60 m
nameTags.anchor: collider top + 0.45 m (bikes: helmet top + 0.35 m); project to screen every frame; hide when behind the camera or off screen
nameTags.occlusion: raycast camera → anchor against track walls/buildings every 100 ms; hidden → fade out over 150 ms
nameTags.overlap: if two tag boxes overlap, move the farther one up by its height + 4 px and draw a 1 px leader line in its colour
nameTags.reticle: tag box inside 60 px of the reticle centre → opacity × 0.35 so it never hides the target
nameTags.own: never in chase / hood / FPV; shown in orange only in replays, spectate and the results podium
content: position chip P1–P6 (tag colour background, #0E1116 text)
hull bar 4 px, tag colour on 18% white
pointer triangle 12×7 px in tag colour
nameTags.targeted: when the local player has gun lock on this car: 2 px pink ring + glow and "◆ TARGET"
nameTags.disconnected: grey #6B7585 tag, plug icon, "RECONNECTING" for up to 10 s, then the car is removed (later, not v1)

rematch.rule: all connected players vote yes → countdown; timer 0 → everyone back to lobby

lobby.startRule: host only; ≥ 2 players; all present players ready
lobby.hostMigration: host leaves → lowest slot number becomes host

strings.hub.title: Race online
strings.hub.quick.sub: Join the next open room · any track
strings.hub.create.sub: Private room · you pick the track · share the code
strings.hub.join.hint: Got a code from a friend? Type it here.
strings.hub.join.count: {n} / 6 · letters and numbers, no O/0 or I/1
strings.search.title: Finding a room…
strings.search.msg: Looking for an open room near you. Rooms start when everyone is ready.
strings.found.title: Room found · {code}
strings.err.full.title: That room is full
strings.err.full.msg: Room {code} already has 6 racers. Ask the host for a new room, or jump into quick match.
strings.err.version.title: Update needed
strings.err.version.msg: This room runs {roomVersion} and you have {myVersion}. Reload the page to update — it takes a few seconds.
strings.err.data.title: Game data out of sync
strings.err.data.msg: This page and the race server have different cars or maps. Reload the page first; if this keeps showing, the server has not been updated yet, so try again in a few minutes. You can still race offline.
strings.err.down.title: Can’t reach the race server
strings.err.down.msg: Check your connection. We’ll try again in {s} s. You can still race offline.
strings.err.notfound.title: No room with that code
strings.err.notfound.msg: Codes are 6 letters and numbers, no O / 0 or I / 1. Check it with the host.
strings.err.empty.title: No open rooms right now
strings.err.empty.msg: Nobody is waiting at the moment. Create a room and share the code — friends can join with it.
strings.lobby.title: Lobby
strings.lobby.open: Open slot · share code {code} to fill it
strings.lobby.start.ok: Everyone is ready · countdown starts for all
strings.lobby.hostonly: Only the host can change the track and laps.
strings.lobby.sameCar: Two racers in the same car? They’re told apart in the race by name tag and colour.
strings.results.title: You finished {place}
strings.results.rematch.sub: Same track, same laps, same room
strings.results.vote.rule: Starts as soon as everyone still in the room says yes. Otherwise everybody goes back to the lobby when the timer runs out.
strings.err.started.title: That race has already started
strings.err.started.msg: Room {code} is mid-race. Try the code again when they’re back in the lobby, or jump into quick match.
strings.err.lost.title: Connection lost
strings.err.lost.msg: You were in room {code} {where}. The room carries on without you — rejoining a race in progress isn’t possible yet.
strings.err.closed.title: Room closed
strings.err.closed.msg: Everyone left room {code}, so it closed. Create a new room or jump into quick match.
strings.lobby.needTwo: Need at least 2 racers · share the code
strings.lobby.youAreHost: {name} left the room · you are now the host
strings.lobby.newHost: {name} left the room · {host} is now the host
strings.name.label: RACER NAME
strings.name.help: Other racers see this in the lobby, on name tags and in the results.
strings.name.changeLater: Change it any time from Online → Edit name.
strings.name.empty: Type a name, or keep the suggestion {suggestion}.
strings.name.tooLong: Too long — {n} characters, the limit is 16.
strings.name.accents: Letters with accents can’t be used: {chars}
strings.name.saved: Saved. This is how other racers will see you.
strings.name.savedNote: Name saved on this device and sent when you join a room.
strings.name.rule.accents: No accents (ọ → o, đ → d) or symbols
strings.name.cutNote: Name tags show the first 12 characters: {tag}
strings.name.capsNote: Name tags show it in capitals
strings.name.sameName: Two racers can pick the same name — the position chip and colour still tell them apart.
strings.loading.me.slow: Still loading — this device is slower than the others
strings.loading.title: Getting everyone ready
strings.loading.rule: Countdown at all-ready, or after 20 s
strings.loading.wait: The countdown starts when everyone is ready · or in {mm:ss}
strings.loading.anyway.join: Starting anyway · {names} will join as soon as they’ve loaded
strings.loading.anyway.drop: Starting anyway · {names} will miss this race
strings.loading.youSlow: Everyone else is ready · starting in {mm:ss} — hang on
strings.finished.label: FINISHED
strings.finished.rule: Anyone not finished in {mm:ss} gets DNF
strings.finished.autopilot: Your car coasts to a stop · weapons off · rivals can still hit it

name.trim: trim spaces at both ends on save
name.why24: the input accepts up to 24 so the "too long" state can be shown; Save stays disabled above 16
name.accentFix: NFD normalise, strip U+0300–U+036F, đ→d Đ→D (button "Remove accents")
name.default: server-generated RACER-### shown pre-filled and selected
name.storage: localStorage voltline.name; ask on first ONLINE only when nothing is stored

loading.lateJoiner: pick strings.loading.anyway.join or .drop to match the server

finished.afterLine: recommended: autopilot at reduced speed, weapons off, can’t be hit; position locked
finished.pause: pause menu stays available (it does not stop the race online)

search.show: elapsed time + typical wait only (no room counter)
